SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT KEP_SEQ FROM KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC WHERE DOC_TYPE = 'RFQ_R' AND BUYER IN ('CNNANT0008') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER, KEY_NO, KEY_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT f_split(data01,'^',1) AS PLANT , key_no as QUOTATION_NO , key_seq as QUOTATION_SEQ , f_split(data01,'^',2) AS REVISION_NO , f_split(data01,'^',3) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , f_split(data01,'^',4) AS UNIT_PRICE , substrb(f_split(data01,'^',5),1,50) AS MAKER_NAME , f_split(data01,'^',6) AS LEAD_TIME , f_split(data01,'^',7) AS UNIT_PRICE2 , substrb(f_split(data01,'^',8),1,50) AS MAKER_NAME2 , f_split(data01,'^',9) AS LEAD_TIME2 , f_split(data01,'^',10) AS UNIT_PRICE3 , substrb(f_split(data01,'^',11),1,50) AS MAKER_NAME3 , f_split(data01,'^',12) AS LEAD_TIME3 , data02 AS ZCOMMENT FROM KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC WHERE KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
UPDATE KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = to_char(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
UPDATE KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = to_char(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
